title: Generative model identifies high-conductivity liquid electrolyte formulations
summary: A predictive model and permutation-invariant generative approach were used to design liquid electrolyte mixtures. The primary v3 preprint reports three experimentally identified formulations with high ionic conductivity and anion-concentrated solvation structure. The later journal abstract additionally mentions cycling stability; that claim is excluded here because its version-specific test was not reviewed.
ai_technology: Predictive model; permutation-invariant mixture model; generative design

evidence.tested: The primary source reports the study-specific result summarized here.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and commercial deployment are not established.
evidence.ai_role: Models predict mixture properties and generate candidate formulations; researchers experimentally measure selected mixtures and solvation structure.

source_review.scope: Primary article/preprint text and metadata as listed in source_checks.
